provenance.title: store-aisle-detection.mp4
provenance.creator: Intel IoT DevKit / sample-videos contributors
provenance.changes: Original 00:08–01:00 excerpt; resampled to 15 fps; audio removed; H.264 transcoding. Analysis outputs add anonymous BBoxes, trails and dwell heatmaps.
provenance.scene: Actual housewares retail store; fixed elevated camera. Not a supermarket food aisle, simulation or generated video.
provenance.attribution: Intel IoT DevKit sample-videos contributors · CC BY 4.0 · modified excerpt

method: Manual homography of estimated BBox bottom-center footpoints; observation-time weighted Gaussian grid
coordinate_system: Unitless normalized floor coordinates u,v in [0,1]. Far edge v=0, camera/front edge v=1. Not metres.
limitations: Floor corners and shelf layout are manually approximated, not surveyed or automatically reconstructed.
Clipped BBox bottoms and points outside the selected floor are excluded.
Detection misses and track fragmentation remain.
This grid differs from the old video heatmap, which accumulated image-space BBox centers.
